history.summary: A 2015 freehold 2BR near Woodleigh MRT (D13) at $1.15M / $1369 PSF — notably below the project's own URA median of $1606 PSF, in the deep-buyer-pool sub-$1.5M band. The technical score is a strong 713/1000 and the resale-only rate is a healthy 4.83%/yr, though that rate rests on only 7 transactions.
history.rating_rationale: Three things line up: (1) $1369 PSF is ~15% below the project URA median of $1606, a real value cushion; (2) freehold 2BR at $1.15M sits in the most liquid price band with the widest tenant/buyer pool; (3) resale-only appreciation of 4.83%/yr with no new-launch bias. Woodleigh MRT (730m), Bidadari estate maturation and Woodleigh Mall are concrete catalysts. The main caveat is the thin 7-txn basis for the rate and Suites@Braddell being a smaller development.

history.summary: Freehold 2BR in D13 (Toa Payoh/Braddell fringe) with a headline -28.3% age-adjusted discount, but the value claim cannot be verified — psf_cohort_txns is 0, so the -1.8% cohort premium rests on zero comparables, and web searches returned no recent Suites@Braddell transactions.
history.rating_rationale: The deep -28.3% discount is the only thing carrying this listing, and it is unsupported: psf_cohort_txns=0 means the -1.8% vs-cohort figure is a data quirk, not a measured bargain, and I could not surface any actual recent Suites@Braddell resale PSF on the web to confirm $1,369 is below market. D13 is RCR-ish (backtest forward ~+3.5%, decent but not top-tier), Braddell MRT and the new The Orie/Braddell Horizon launches are nearby supports, but freehold is explicitly not a forward edge per the v3.4 priors. With the value signal unverifiable and an 840 sqft 2BR in a small boutique block, this is a Neutral until real comps confirm the discount.
